patch_description: Structural redesign into a modular three-stage pipeline: (1) robust statistics stage (MAD-based noise/acceleration estimation), (2) banded Whittaker smoother stage (O(n) pentadiagonal solve, uniform lambda with local curvature relaxation), and (3) a new flip-elimination damper that fixes the polarity flaw of prior reversal dampers: instead of shrinking sub-threshold sign flips (keep=0.25, which preserved the flip's sign), it removes them entirely by zeroing the conflicting difference and holding the line. Applied as a forward sweep plus mirrored backward sweep (zero-phase), with prev_d tracked from pre-damp differences to avoid zero-stall, and a corr>=0.97 guard with keep=0.5 retry. This directly attacks slope_changes and false_reversals while keeping lag low via the zero-phase banded solve.
